items.title: 61427_Happy Caldwell oral history interview
items.q: Like the McRae brothers, they brought a terrific band from Philadelphia years ago. ... Teddy, Dave, all of them.

ctx.x: There were two White brothers, a lot of cousins played, but now his brother was a very nice French piano player. Never could get along. Like the McRae brothers, they brought a terrific band from Philadelphia years ago.
